scripts.name: timeblock-organizer
scripts.description: Pull-watches daily pages and reorganizes time-prefixed TODOs into the #TimeBlock parent, sorted by start-time, with the SmartBlock timestamp button pinned last. Fixes scheduling bugs in any writer (Chief of Staff, Better Tasks, manual edits). v1.1.0 adds conflict detection + opt-in auto-resolve. v1.1.4 adds #concurrent opt-out for intentional overlaps, loose-sort fallback for incomplete entries, and parks untimed blocks at the bottom (not top).

scripts.name: auto-attribute-todo
scripts.description: Auto-fills BT_attr* on new {{[[TODO]]}} blocks via LiveAI_API. Phase 3 semantic embeddings via Gemini. v1.8.0: log housekeeping (per-day grouping + auto-prune) + ((uid)) block-ref following. v1.8.1: page-context project adoption (TODO on a Project Status:: Active page inherits that project). v1.8.2: pause-on-network-pressure + parallel BT_attr writes. v1.8.3: scan default 60min→30min after retiring nautilus (the actual sync bottleneck was inbound apply lag, not outbound writes).
